title: SMFNet diffusion model links single-molecule chromatin states to TF assemblies
summary: SMFNet, a generative diffusion model, predicts distributions of single-molecule chromatin accessibility profiles from DNA sequence, and PRISM identifies sequence features tied to individual states. Experimental perturbation of the associated motifs redistributed states as SMFNet predicted. In silico motif screens showed that transcription factors differ in accessible-region width and nucleosome-positioning precision, and that motif combinations have partner- and spacing-dependent effects; natural variation at an endogenous element supported this in vivo. Only the abstract was reviewed.
